page.overview:
Who is Maia?

Maia was a Dunedain girl of the refuge of Taurdal.

She is non-canonical as she does not appear in the works of J.R.R. Tolkien and is only in the fan-film Born of Hope.

When Maia’s village was attacked and her family killed by invading Orcs, she fled north with many other refugees that found their way to Taurdal. There, she was adopted by Evonyn and Halbaron, making her the adopted sister of Halbarad.Category:Characters in Born of Hope Category:Non-canonical Dúnedain
